description.value: Six Acres is a cozy pub-restaurant in Vancouver's historic Gastown neighbourhood, describing itself as sitting halfway between a classic pub and a trendy bar, serving craft cocktails, culinary classics, and local and global beers. The space is explicitly family-friendly and welcomes dogs on its patio, making it a welcoming stop in a walkable, cyclist-friendly part of the city. Its menu spans brunch, lunch, dinner, happy hour, and a Sunday roast with both meat and vegan options.
